Label: Maintenance regimen definition
Definition (Validated from Protocol): A maintenance regimen is a period of 120 days or longer during which only a valid maintenance therapy is available (see valid maintenance therapies below). Maintenance is not required to be prescribed continuously for the duration of the 120 day period. Furthermore, the maintenance therapy must have been a part of the LOT's initial regimen (for LOT1 the initial regimen includes all MM therapies identified during the first 60 days of LOT1, for LOT2-5 the initial regimen is defined as all MM therapies identified during the first 30 days of the LOT).
Additional Notes (Validated from Protoco: Protocol Section 5.1.1 Maintenance regimen: 'A maintenance regimen is a period of 120 days or longer during which only a valid maintenance therapy is available. Maintenance is not required to be prescribed continuously for the duration of the 120 day period. Furthermore, the maintenance therapy must have been a part of the LOT's initial regimen.'
